annotations.title: Send a pitch to Mode VC

description: Sends a founder's structured Common App pitch packet to the Mode VC team (pre-seed and seed AI companies, checks of US$25K to $100K; see get_mode_vc_thesis_and_criteria). This tool shares data: the founder name, email, company, one-line pitch, stage, deck link and optional traction/raise metrics go to Mode VC. Show the founder exactly what will be sent and set consent to true only after they agree. When include_vc_matches is true (default), also returns matched public VC pitch forms from match_vc_intake_forms with prefill URLs so the founder can reuse the same packet elsewhere. Same intake as https://modevc.com/contact.

consent.description: Must be true: the founder has seen these details and agreed to send them to Mode VC.

deck_url.description: Optional link to the deck (http or https).

distribution_moat.description: Optional summary of distribution loop, channel advantage, or proprietary operational data.

email.description: Email the founder wants Mode VC to reply to.

founder_linkedin.description: Optional founder LinkedIn profile URL (http or https).

hq_location.description: Optional startup headquarters city and country.

include_vc_matches.description: Default true: return matched public VC pitch forms and Common App prefill answers alongside Mode VC confirmation.

monthly_revenue_usd.description: Optional current monthly revenue or GMV in US dollars.

office_hours.description: True to ask for a 20-minute office hours call.

one_liner.description: One sentence on what the company does and for whom (up to 300 characters).

raising_usd.description: Optional target round size in US dollars.

sector.description: Optional primary sector (for example AI and data, Vertical AI, Dev tools, Enterprise software).

valuation_cap_usd.description: Optional valuation cap or target pre-money valuation in US dollars.

website_url.description: Optional company website URL (http or https).

name: apply_to_mode_vc
